_comment: The score: a bar-line edit of one Eleven Music take (music_v2_5, seed 7101, 152 s, 120.004 BPM, beats at 0.0065 + k/2 s) onto the film from R (score clock 0 = film frame R = 277; 146.0 s = 4380 f). The take followed the plan's contrasts but ran its Night section 3 bars long, so the lift sits at source 32.0 (plan 26) and the final hit at source 144.0 (plan 138); the rest of the plan (resolve, build) it played as one steady groove. One splice removes source 6-12 (3 Night bars; the 2-loud/2-quiet bar pattern of the mid band carries on across it), so after film 6 every film time = source time - 6: the lift lands on A2's first frame (film 26), the take's own final hit on endHit (film 138), its ring-out ends with the film (146 = source 152). P4 is made to resolve with a low-pass (900 Hz) from P4's start that opens over the 2 bars before snapBack, plus a small synthesized sub hit on snapBack; P5-A4 build with a 3-bar synthesized riser and a 2-bar high-pass into endHit, where a big sub hit doubles the take's own hit.

segments.why: M1 title swell (0-4, from silence) and the first Night bar (4-6)
Night from source bar 6 (source 6-12 removed), the lift at film 26 = source 32, the groove, the final hit at film 138 = source 144, the ring-out to film 146 = source 152

sweeps.why: M5: P4's review, the groove muffled on P4's first frame
M5: the filter opens over the 2 bars before snapBack
M6: 2-bar high-pass build, full band back on endHit

gain.why: the ring-out fades to silence on the film's last frame

subHits.why: M5: the small hit on snapBack (V22, Verified)
M7: the final hit on the end card (endHit), doubling the take's own hit

cues.what: warm title swell from silence under V01 (no drums)
Night: low pulse on the beat, ticking hats, dark pad; mid band alternates 2 loud / 2 quiet bars and rises over the last 3 bars
Day lift on A2's first frame: kick on the beat, backbeat, bright synths
steady groove (P1-P3); kick drop-out fills at 56-58 and 72.5-73.5
P4: groove muffled (low-pass 900 Hz), opening 114-116; full band and a small sub hit on snapBack (116)
P5-A4: groove; riser from 132 and high-pass build 134-138
final hit on endHit (the take's hit plus a sub hit), ring-out to silence at the film's end

expect._why: timeline.mjs checks these against src/data/timeline.json (seconds from R); a mismatch marks the score stale
